answer: This network's sybil resistance is per-identity proof-of-work re-armed every epoch: the node custodies a material key, so each fresh wallet must rehash from scratch and a farm pays that compute per clone it mints — a rig spinning a thousand heads pays a thousand times, an honest miner once. Add peer attestation flowing both ways like an ocean current: a ring that vouches only inward never settles its pending book, and its mutual vouches are a walnut beside the prism of scarce established judgment grading the queue. Cost per fake head rises faster than any attacker can amortize.
